source_refs.note: Book p. 192-194: 10.6 Triple Angle Identities, statements (i)-(iii), proofs, Examples 11-13; stops before Exercise 10.3. Misprints: 'os 2a' and two tan 3a lines in the proofs, Example 12(ii) 'sin 2t'.

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Pichhle do sabaq mein humne double angle (\(2\alpha\)) aur half angle (\(\frac{\alpha}{2}\)) ke formulas seekhe. Aaj hum ek qadam aage jayenge: triple angle (teen guna zaviya), yani \(3\alpha\). Sawal yeh hai ke agar humein \(\sin\alpha\) maloom ho to kya hum \(\sin 3\alpha\) nikal sakte hain, bina \(3\alpha\) ki table dekhe? Jawab hai haan, aur iska tareeqa bohat seedha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is poore sabaq ki chaabi ek line hai: \(3\alpha = 2\alpha + \alpha\). Jaise hi hum \(3\alpha\) ko do angles ka sum likh dete hain, 10.3 ke sum formulas (\(\sin(A + B)\), \(\cos(A + B)\), \(\tan(A + B)\)) lag jate hain. Phir \(2\alpha\) wale hisson ke liye 10.4 ke double angle formulas laga dete hain. Yani naya kuch ratta nahin, sirf purane formulas ko tarteeb se jorna hai.
Misal ke taur par: agar aap ko 2 ka table aata hai aur 1 jorna aata hai, to 3 khud ban jata hai. Yahan bhi yahi hai.
Kitab teen identities deti hai (identity (shanakht / aisi barabari jo har angle ke liye sach ho)):

blocks.text_alt: sine of 3 alpha equals 3 sine alpha minus 4 sine cubed alpha, identity (i)
cosine of 3 alpha equals 4 cosine cubed alpha minus 3 cosine alpha, identity (ii)
tangent of 3 alpha equals 3 tangent alpha minus tangent cubed alpha, over 1 minus 3 tangent squared alpha, identity (iii)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
In teeno ko ghaur se dekhiye, ek khoobsurat pattern hai: \(\sin 3\alpha\) ki R.H.S. mein sirf \(\sin\alpha\) hai, \(\cos 3\alpha\) mein sirf \(\cos\alpha\), aur \(\tan 3\alpha\) mein sirf \(\tan\alpha\). Isi liye har proof mein hum soch samajh kar \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki woh form chunte hain jo hamare target se mile, aur \(\sin^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\alpha = 1\) se faltu function ko badal dete hain.
Khud sochiye: \(\alpha = 30^{\circ}\) rakh kar (i) ko check kijiye. \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\) hona chahiye. (Jawab: \(3\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) - 4\left(\frac{1}{8}\right) = \frac{3}{2} - \frac{1}{2} = 1\). Bilkul sahi!)
Proof

(i) Sab se pehle \(3\alpha\) ko \(2\alpha + \alpha\) likhte hain, phir \(\sin(A + B) = \sin A\cos B + \cos A\sin B\) lagate hain:
\[\sin 3\alpha = \sin(2\alpha + \alpha)\]
\[= \sin 2\alpha\cos\alpha + \cos 2\alpha\sin\alpha\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\cos\alpha\]
\[\quad + (1 - 2\sin^{2}\alpha)\sin\alpha\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha\cos^{2}\alpha + \sin\alpha - 2\sin^{3}\alpha\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha(1 - \sin^{2}\alpha)\]
\[\quad + \sin\alpha - 2\sin^{3}\alpha\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha - 2\sin^{3}\alpha + \sin\alpha - 2\sin^{3}\alpha\]
\[\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha - 4\sin^{3}\alpha\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har line ka matlab samajhiye:
1. \(\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) rakha (10.4 ka formula).
2. \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki teen forms hain. Humne \(1 - 2\sin^{2}\alpha\) kyun chuni? Kyun ke hamara target sirf \(\sin\alpha\) wala jawab hai. Agar \(2\cos^{2}\alpha - 1\) le lete to \(\cos\) aur barh jata.
3. Phir bhi ek \(\cos^{2}\alpha\) bacha, use \(1 - \sin^{2}\alpha\) se badal diya.
4. Aakhir mein milte julte terms jama kiye: \(2\sin\alpha + \sin\alpha = 3\sin\alpha\), aur \(-2\sin^{3}\alpha - 2\sin^{3}\alpha = -4\sin^{3}\alpha\).
Dekha? Har qadam ka ek maqsad hai: jo function nahin chahiye, use hatao.

(ii) Ab bilkul isi tarah \(\cos(A + B) = \cos A\cos B - \sin A\sin B\) lagate hain:
\[\cos 3\alpha = \cos(2\alpha + \alpha)\]
\[= \cos 2\alpha\cos\alpha - \sin 2\alpha\sin\alpha\]
\[= (2\cos^{2}\alpha - 1)\cos\alpha\]
\[\quad - 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\sin\alpha\]
\[= 2\cos^{3}\alpha - \cos\alpha - 2\sin^{2}\alpha\cos\alpha\]
\[= 2\cos^{3}\alpha - \cos\alpha\]
\[\quad - 2(1 - \cos^{2}\alpha)\cos\alpha\]
\[= 2\cos^{3}\alpha - \cos\alpha - 2\cos\alpha + 2\cos^{3}\alpha\]
\[\cos 3\alpha = 4\cos^{3}\alpha - 3\cos\alpha\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein proof (ii) ki doosri line mein "os 2α cos α" chhapa hai, yani "c" chhoot gaya hai. Sahi line yeh hai: \(\cos 2\alpha\cos\alpha - \sin 2\alpha\sin\alpha\). Yeh sirf printing ki ghalti hai, baqi proof theek hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Is dafa target sirf \(\cos\alpha\) hai, is liye \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki form \(2\cos^{2}\alpha - 1\) chuni gayi, aur \(\sin^{2}\alpha\) ko \(1 - \cos^{2}\alpha\) se badla gaya. Dhyan dein: \(-2(1 - \cos^{2}\alpha)\cos\alpha\) kholte waqt minus sign andar dono terms par lagta hai: \(-2\cos\alpha + 2\cos^{3}\alpha\). Bohat se students yahan \(-2\cos^{3}\alpha\) likh dete hain aur jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

(iii) Yahan \(\tan(A + B) = \frac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A\tan B}\) aur \(\tan 2\alpha = \frac{2\tan\alpha}{1 - \tan^{2}\alpha}\) dono istemal honge:
\[\tan 3\alpha = \tan(2\alpha + \alpha)\]
\[= \dfrac{\tan 2\alpha + \tan\alpha}{1 - \tan 2\alpha\,\tan\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{\dfrac{2\tan\alpha}{1 - \tan^{2}\alpha} + \tan\alpha}{1 - \dfrac{2\tan\alpha}{1 - \tan^{2}\alpha}\cdot\tan\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{2\tan\alpha + \tan\alpha - \tan^{3}\alpha}{1 - \tan^{2}\alpha - 2\tan^{2}\alpha}\]
\[\tan 3\alpha = \dfrac{3\tan\alpha - \tan^{3}\alpha}{1 - 3\tan^{2}\alpha}\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Proof (iii) mein kitab do jagah ghalat chhapti hai. (1) Doosri line mein \(\tan 2\alpha\) ki jagah \(\tan^{2}\alpha\) chhapa hai; sahi \(\dfrac{\tan 2\alpha + \tan\alpha}{1 - \tan 2\alpha\tan\alpha}\) hai. (2) Aakhri line ki L.H.S. \(\tan^{3}\alpha\) chhapi hai; sahi \(\tan 3\alpha\) hai. Dono mein bara farq hai: \(\tan 3\alpha\) ka matlab teen guna angle ka tan, jab ke \(\tan^{3}\alpha\) ka matlab \(\tan\alpha\) ka cube.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Woh qadam jo kitab nahin dikhati: \(\tan 2\alpha\) rakhne ke baad fraction ke andar fraction ban jata hai, jo dekhne mein dara deta hai. Iska ilaaj: bari fraction ke upar aur neeche dono ko \(1 - \tan^{2}\alpha\) se multiply kar dein. Kyun? Kyun ke andar wali chhoti fractions ka denominator yahi hai, to woh khatam ho jayega.
Numerator: \(2\tan\alpha + \tan\alpha(1 - \tan^{2}\alpha) = 3\tan\alpha - \tan^{3}\alpha\)
Denominator: \((1 - \tan^{2}\alpha) - 2\tan^{2}\alpha = 1 - 3\tan^{2}\alpha\)
Yaad rahe: yeh formula tab hi chalta hai jab \(1 - 3\tan^{2}\alpha \ne 0\), misal ke taur par \(\alpha = 30^{\circ}\) par \(\tan 90^{\circ}\) defined hi nahin.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ki misaal nahin. \(\cos 180^{\circ}\) ko formula (ii) se nikaliye, \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\) le kar.
Hal: \(\cos 180^{\circ} = 4\cos^{3}60^{\circ} - 3\cos 60^{\circ} = 4\left(\frac{1}{8}\right) - 3\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{2} - \frac{3}{2} = -1\). Aur hum jaante hain ke \(\cos 180^{\circ} = -1\). Formula ne sahi jawab diya.
Isi tarah \(\alpha = 15^{\circ}\) par (iii) se \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) aata hai; calculator ho to khud check kijiye.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Exam mein aksar seedha pooch liya jata hai "prove that \(\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha - 4\sin^{3}\alpha\)". Is liye teeno proofs ka raasta zehan mein rakhiye: \(3\alpha = 2\alpha + \alpha\), sum formula, double angle formula, aur aakhir mein \(\sin^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\alpha = 1\). Formula ratne ke bajaye yeh chaar qadam yaad hon to aap koi bhi proof khud bana lenge, chahe exam mein ghabrahat ho.

Ab kitab teen misaalein deti hai. Yeh misaalein triple angle se zyada double angle (10.4) ke formulas ki practice hain, lekin soch wahi hai: mushkil angle ko aasan forms mein badlo, phir factor ya cancel karo. Chaliye ek ek kar ke dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Example 11
steps:
Given: ek identity jo prove karni hai.
To prove: \(\dfrac{\sin\theta + \sin 2\theta}{1 + \cos\theta + \cos 2\theta} = \tan\theta\).
Method: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke kaun si side mushkil hai. L.H.S. mein \(2\theta\) wale terms hain, R.H.S. sirf \(\tan\theta\) hai. Rule yeh hai ke hamesha mushkil side se shuru karo aur use aasan side tak le jao. Plan: \(\sin 2\theta\) aur \(\cos 2\theta\) ko \(\theta\) mein badlo, phir common factor nikal kar cancel karo.

Step 1: Double angles ko kholna
\[\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta\]
\[\cos 2\theta = 2\cos^{2}\theta - 1\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\theta\) ki teen forms mein se humne \(2\cos^{2}\theta - 1\) chuni, kyun ke iska \(-1\) denominator ke \(+1\) ko khatam kar dega. Agar \(1 - 2\sin^{2}\theta\) lete to \(1 + 1 = 2\) ban jata aur kaam ulajh jata. Sahi form chunna hi asal hunar hai.

Step 2: L.H.S. mein rakhna
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin\theta + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta + 2\cos^{2}\theta - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin\theta + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos\theta + 2\cos^{2}\theta}\]
Kyun: denominator mein \(1 - 1 = 0\) ho gaya, jaisa humne socha tha.

Step 3: Common factor nikalna
\[= \dfrac{\sin\theta(1 + 2\cos\theta)}{\cos\theta(1 + 2\cos\theta)}\]
Kyun: numerator ke dono terms mein \(\sin\theta\) common hai aur denominator ke dono terms mein \(\cos\theta\). Dekhiye, bracket mein dono jagah bilkul ek jaisa \((1 + 2\cos\theta)\) bacha. Yahi woh lamha hai jahan sawal hal hota hai.

Step 4: Cancel kar ke simplify
\[= \dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: upar neeche ek hi non-zero factor ho to use cancel kar sakte hain, jaise \(\frac{3 \times 5}{4 \times 5} = \frac{3}{4}\). Aur \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\) ki definition hi \(\tan\theta\) hai.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\) rakh kar dekhte hain.
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + 1}{1 + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + 0} = 1\]
aur \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Dono sides barabar, matlab hamara proof sahi raste par hai.

blocks.title: Example 12
steps:
Given: do formulas jo show karne hain.
To prove: (i) \(\sin 2\theta = \frac{2\tan\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\), (ii) \(\cos 2\theta = \frac{1 - \tan^{2}\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\).
Method: R.H.S. mein sirf \(\tan\theta\) hai, jab ke L.H.S. \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) mein hai. \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) ko \(\tan\) banane ka tareeqa: \(\cos\) ki power se divide karna. Lekin divide karne ke liye fraction chahiye, is liye pehle L.H.S. ko \(1\) par likhenge, aur \(1\) ki jagah \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta\) rakhenge. Yeh ek mashhoor chaal hai: "1 ko smart tareeqe se likho".

(i) Step 1: \(\sin 2\theta\) ko 1 par likhna
\[\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \dfrac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{1}\]
\[= \dfrac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta}\]
Kyun: \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta = 1\) hai, is liye value bilkul nahin badli. Faida yeh hua ke ab denominator ko \(1 + \tan^{2}\theta\) banaya ja sakta hai.

(i) Step 2: Upar neeche \(\cos^{2}\theta\) se divide
\[= \dfrac{\frac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}}{\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta} + \frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\]
\[\sin 2\theta = \dfrac{2\tan\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\]
Kyun: fraction ke upar aur neeche ko ek hi non-zero number se divide karein to fraction ki value nahin badalti. Upar \(\frac{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}\) mein ek \(\cos\theta\) cancel ho kar \(2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = 2\tan\theta\) bachta hai.

(ii) Step 1: \(\cos 2\theta\) ko 1 par likhna
\[\cos 2\theta = \cos^{2}\theta - \sin^{2}\theta\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos^{2}\theta - \sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta}\]
Kyun: wahi chaal. \(\cos 2\theta\) ki teen forms mein se \(\cos^{2}\theta - \sin^{2}\theta\) is liye chuni ke is ke dono terms \(\cos^{2}\theta\) se divide ho kar \(1\) aur \(\tan^{2}\theta\) ban jate hain. Dhyan dein: kitab agli line mein denominator ghalti se \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin 2\theta\) chhapti hai; sahi \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta\) hai (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).

(ii) Step 2: Upar neeche \(\cos^{2}\theta\) se divide
\[= \dfrac{\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta} - \frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}}{\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta} + \frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}}\]
\[\cos 2\theta = \dfrac{1 - \tan^{2}\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\]
Kyun: har term ko \(\cos^{2}\theta\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{\cos^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta} = 1\) aur \(\frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta} = \tan^{2}\theta\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) lein, \(\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), \(\tan^{2}30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{3}\).
\[\dfrac{2/\sqrt{3}}{1 + 1/3} = \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot\dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\dfrac{1 - 1/3}{1 + 1/3} = \dfrac{2/3}{4/3} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Aur waqai \(\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Dono formulas sahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 12(ii) mein jis line mein upar neeche \(\cos^{2}\theta\) se divide kiya gaya hai, wahan kitab denominator \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin 2\theta\) chhapti hai. Sahi \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta\) hai (jo 1 ke barabar hai). Agli line mein kitab khud \(\frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta}\) likhti hai, to yeh sirf printing ki ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Example 12 ke dono nataij yaad rakhne ke qabil hain: in se \(\sin 2\theta\) aur \(\cos 2\theta\) sirf \(\tan\theta\) mein likhe ja sakte hain. Agar (i) ko (ii) se divide karein to \(\tan 2\theta = \frac{2\tan\theta}{1 - \tan^{2}\theta}\) mil jata hai, jo 10.4 ka formula hai. Yeh tab hi chalte hain jab \(\cos\theta \ne 0\).

blocks.title: Example 13
blocks.problem: Reduce \(\cos^{4}\theta\) to an expression involving only function of multiples of \(\theta\), raised to the first power.
steps:
Given: \(\cos^{4}\theta\).
To find: aisi barabar expression jis mein sirf \(\cos 2\theta\), \(\cos 4\theta\) jaise terms hon, aur har ek ki power sirf 1 ho (koi square ya fourth power nahin).
Method: sawal ki zabaan ko samajhna zaroori hai. "Raised to the first power" ka matlab: power hatao, lekin angle barha do. Iska aala hathiyar hai power-reducing formula \(\cos^{2}\theta = \frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\), jo hum do dafa lagayenge: ek dafa \(\theta\) ke liye, ek dafa \(2\theta\) ke liye.

Step 1: Power-reducing formula banana
\[2\cos^{2}\theta = 1 + \cos 2\theta\]
\[\Rightarrow \cos^{2}\theta = \dfrac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: yeh \(\cos 2\theta = 2\cos^{2}\theta - 1\) se aata hai (1 ko doosri taraf le gaye aur 2 se divide kiya). Is formula ki khoobi yeh hai ke square ko ek double angle ki pehli power mein badal deta hai, aur sawal yahi maang raha hai.

Step 2: \(\cos^{4}\theta\) ko square ki shakal mein likhna
\[\cos^{4}\theta = (\cos^{2}\theta)^{2} = \left[\dfrac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\right]^{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + 2\cos 2\theta + \cos^{2}2\theta}{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left[1 + 2\cos 2\theta + \cos^{2}2\theta\right]\]
Kyun: \(\cos^{4}\theta\) asal mein \(\cos^{2}\theta\) ka square hai. \((a + b)^{2} = a^{2} + 2ab + b^{2}\) lagaya, jahan \(a = 1\) aur \(b = \cos 2\theta\); neeche \(2^{2} = 4\).

Step 3: \(\cos^{2}2\theta\) ko phir se reduce karna
\[\cos^{2}2\theta = \dfrac{1 + \cos 4\theta}{2}\]
\[\cos^{4}\theta = \dfrac{1}{4}\left[1 + 2\cos 2\theta + \dfrac{1 + \cos 4\theta}{2}\right]\]
Kyun: \(\cos^{2}2\theta\) abhi bhi square hai, to kaam adhoora hai. Wahi formula, bas \(\theta\) ki jagah \(2\theta\): angle double ho kar \(4\theta\) ban gaya.

Step 4: Simplify karna
\[= \dfrac{1}{4\times 2}\left[2 + 4\cos 2\theta + 1 + \cos 4\theta\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{8}\left[3 + 4\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta\right]\]
Kyun: bracket ke andar wala \(\frac{1}{2}\) bahar nikalne ke liye andar ke har term ko 2 se multiply kiya aur bahar \(\frac{1}{4}\) ko \(\frac{1}{8}\) bana diya. Phir \(2 + 1 = 3\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 0^{\circ}\): \(\cos^{4}0^{\circ} = 1\) aur \(\frac{1}{8}(3 + 4 + 1) = 1\).
\(\theta = 90^{\circ}\): \(\cos^{4}90^{\circ} = 0\) aur \(\frac{1}{8}(3 + 4(-1) + 1) = 0\). Dono jagah jawab mil gaya.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh kaam kyun karte hain? \(\cos^{4}\theta\) jaisi powers ke saath kaam karna mushkil hota hai, jab ke \(\cos 2\theta\), \(\cos 4\theta\) ki pehli power aasan hai. Aage calculus mein integration karte waqt yahi tareeqa bohat kaam aata hai. \(\sin^{4}\theta\) ke liye bhi bilkul yahi tareeqa hai, bas \(\sin^{2}\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\) lagta hai (Exercise 10.3 mein aap khud karenge).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(\cos^{3}\theta\) ko first powers mein kaise likhenge? Ishara: formula (ii) \(\cos 3\theta = 4\cos^{3}\theta - 3\cos\theta\) ko \(\cos^{3}\theta\) ke liye hal kijiye.
(Jawab: \(\cos^{3}\theta = \frac{3\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta}{4}\). Isi tarah (i) se \(\sin^{3}\theta = \frac{3\sin\theta - \sin 3\theta}{4}\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Har triple angle proof \(3\alpha = 2\alpha + \alpha\) se shuru hota hai.
2. \(\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha - 4\sin^{3}\alpha\) (sirf sines).
3. \(\cos 3\alpha = 4\cos^{3}\alpha - 3\cos\alpha\) (sirf cosines; signs ki tarteeb ulti).
4. \(\tan 3\alpha = \frac{3\tan\alpha - \tan^{3}\alpha}{1 - 3\tan^{2}\alpha}\).
5. \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki form target dekh kar chuno: sines chahiye to \(1 - 2\sin^{2}\alpha\), cosines chahiye to \(2\cos^{2}\alpha - 1\).
6. \(\sin 2\theta = \frac{2\tan\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\), \(\cos 2\theta = \frac{1 - \tan^{2}\theta}{1 + \tan^{2}\theta}\).
7. Power hatani ho to \(\cos^{2}\theta = \frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}\) aur \(\sin^{2}\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Signs ulat dena: \(\sin 3\alpha\) mein \(3\) pehle aata hai, \(\cos 3\alpha\) mein \(4\) pehle. Shak ho to \(\alpha = 0^{\circ}\) rakh kar dekhiye: \(\cos 0^{\circ} = 1 = 4 - 3\), aur \(\sin 0^{\circ} = 0 = 0 - 0\).
2. \(\sin 3\alpha = 3\sin\alpha\) likh dena: 3 ko sine ke bahar nahin nikal sakte. \(\alpha = 90^{\circ}\) par dekhiye: \(\sin 270^{\circ} = -1\), jab ke \(3\sin 90^{\circ} = 3\).
3. \(\tan 3\alpha\) aur \(\tan^{3}\alpha\) ko ek samajhna; pehla teen guna angle hai, doosra cube.
4. Example 13 mein \(\cos^{2}2\theta\) ko reduce karna bhool jana; aakhri jawab mein koi square nahin hona chahiye.
5. Minus bracket kholte waqt sign ki ghalti: \(-2(1 - \cos^{2}\alpha) = -2 + 2\cos^{2}\alpha\).
